title: A Day at the Market
description: A simple story about shopping at a weekend market with a grandmother.
instructions: Read the text about a weekend market, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Every Saturday, there is a market in my town. It is in the big square near the library. The market opens at eight o'clock in the morning. Many people go there.
Last Saturday, I went to the market with my grandmother. We bought apples, tomatoes and fresh bread. The apples were cheap, only two dollars for a bag. My grandmother also bought some yellow flowers.
At ten o'clock, we were hungry. We ate hot soup at a small cafe. Then we walked home with our heavy bags. It was a happy morning.
My grandmother goes to the market every week. She knows many of the sellers. Her friend Mr Lopez sells eggs and cheese. He always gives me a small piece of cheese to try. It is very good.
There is often a man with a big black hat at the market. He plays the guitar in the middle of the square. People stop and listen to him. Last Saturday, I put a coin in his hat. He smiled at me.
The market is very crowded at eleven o'clock. There are many people and it is very noisy. My grandmother says, 'Come early, before the crowds!' That is why we always go at eight o'clock.

At home, I helped my grandmother. I washed the apples and put the flowers in a vase. In the evening, we made a tomato salad and ate it with the fresh bread. I want to go to the market again next Saturday.
